name: --color-text-primary
description: Headings and body text on bg-primary, bg-secondary and bg-tertiary. Don't use on brand or inverse fills — use text-on-brand / text-inverse.

name: --color-text-secondary
description: Supporting copy, labels, descriptions and table cells on bg-primary and bg-secondary. Don't use for disabled text — use text-disabled.

name: --color-text-white
description: Always white in both themes — text on photos and fixed dark fills. Don't use on theme-aware surfaces — use text-primary or text-inverse.

name: --color-text-opacity
description: Text at 60% opacity over imagery or any background. Don't use for hint text on surfaces — use text-tertiary.

name: --color-text-link
description: Inline links on bg-primary and bg-secondary. Pair with an underline or hover change; don't use for non-interactive emphasis — use text-brand.

name: --color-text-tertiary
description: Hints, timestamps, metadata and helper text on bg-primary and bg-secondary. Don't use for body copy or placeholders.

name: --color-text-placeholder
description: Placeholder text inside inputs only, on bg-primary. Never use for labels or entered values.

name: --color-text-disabled
description: Labels of disabled controls; exempt from contrast rules. Don't use to de-emphasise active content — use text-tertiary.

name: --color-text-brand
description: Brand-coloured text: highlighted words and active nav labels on bg-primary and bg-brand-subtle. Don't use on bg-brand-solid — use text-on-brand.

name: --color-text-on-brand
description: Labels on bg-brand-solid (the primary button). Only on brand-solid fills.

name: --color-text-error
description: Error messages and destructive labels on bg-primary and bg-error-subtle. Don't use on bg-error-solid — use text-white.

name: --color-text-warning
description: Warning text on bg-primary and bg-warning-subtle. Don't use on bg-warning-solid — use text-on-warning.

name: --color-text-success
description: Success text on bg-primary and bg-success-subtle.

name: --color-text-brand-hover
description: Hover state of text-brand and text-link. Only for the hover state.

name: --color-text-inverse
description: Text on bg-inverse (tooltips, dark banners). Only on bg-inverse.

name: --color-text-on-warning
description: Text on bg-warning-solid (solid warning badges). Always Gray 900 — white on amber is only 2.2:1.

name: --color-text-ai
description: AI label text and AI accents ("AI generated", "Thought for 12s"). Meets 4.5:1 on bg-primary and bg-ai-subtle. Not for body copy. Value shown for the Atomus brand; code follows the active brand: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-brand-700) 55%, var(--color-purple-700))

name: --color-gradient-primary-start
description: Start stop of the primary gradient (hero and promo backgrounds). Decorative only — never behind body text without a scrim.

name: --color-gradient-primary-end
description: End stop of the primary gradient (hero and promo backgrounds). Decorative only.

name: --color-gradient-secondary-start

name: --color-gradient-secondary-end

name: --color-gradient-tertiary-end

name: --color-bg-primary
description: Default page and card surface. Pair with text-primary and border-secondary.

name: --color-bg-primary-hover
description: Hover on rows, menu items and list items that sit on bg-primary. Only for hover, never as a resting fill.

name: --color-bg-secondary
description: Sidebars, section bands, table headers and subtle panels. Don't nest bg-secondary inside bg-secondary — step to bg-tertiary.

name: --color-bg-tertiary
description: Stronger neutral fill: chips, wells, tracks, image placeholders and secondary buttons.

name: --color-bg-inverse
description: Inverted surfaces: tooltips and dark banners. Always pair with text-inverse and fg-inverse.

name: --color-bg-disabled
description: Fill of disabled controls. Pair with text-disabled and border-disabled.

name: --color-bg-brand-solid
description: Primary brand fill: primary buttons, checked controls, progress fills, active states. Use text-on-brand / fg-on-brand on top; one primary action per view.

name: --color-bg-brand-solid-hover
description: Hover of bg-brand-solid. Only for the hover state.

name: --color-bg-brand-subtle
description: Light brand tint: selected rows, info areas, brand badges. Use text-brand or text-primary on top.

name: --color-bg-error-solid
description: Destructive buttons and error dots. Use text-white on top; reserve for destructive actions.

name: --color-bg-error-subtle
description: Error alert, field and badge background. Use text-error on top.

name: --color-bg-warning-subtle
description: Warning alert and badge background. Use text-warning on top.

name: --color-bg-success-subtle
description: Success alert and badge background. Use text-success on top.

name: --color-bg-tertiary-hover
description: Hover on bg-tertiary fills (secondary buttons, chips). Only for the hover state.

name: --color-bg-warning-solid
description: Solid warning fill: badges, dots. Use text-on-warning / fg-on-warning on top — never white.

name: --color-bg-success-solid
description: Solid success fill: badges, dots. Use text-white on top.

name: --color-bg-overlay
description: Scrim behind modals and drawers. Only for overlays, never as a surface.

name: --color-bg-quaternary
description: Strongest neutral fill: toggle tracks (off), slider and progress tracks.

name: --color-bg-quaternary-hover
description: Hover on bg-quaternary fills. Only for the hover state.

name: --color-bg-ai-subtle
description: AI surface tint: AI messages, reasoning, AI label chips and approval cards. Brand blended with purple so AI reads as related to, but distinct from, the brand. Pair with text-ai or text-primary. Value shown for the Atomus brand; code follows the active brand: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-brand-50) 55%, var(--color-purple-50))

name: --color-border-primary
description: Borders of inputs and outlined controls. Decorative strength (≈1.5:1) — always pair a control border with a visible label; use border-focus for focus.

name: --color-border-secondary
description: Card outlines, dividers and table rules. Don't use for input borders — use border-primary.

name: --color-border-disabled
description: Borders of disabled controls.

name: --color-border-brand
description: Selected / active border: selected cards, active tabs. Don't use for focus — use border-focus.

name: --color-border-focus
description: Focus outline colour of every interactive control; pair with the focus ring shadow. Only for :focus-visible.

name: --color-border-error
description: Inputs and cards in an error state. Pair with a text-error message.

name: --color-border-warning
description: Inputs, alerts and cards in a warning state.

name: --color-border-success
description: Inputs, alerts and cards in a success state.

name: --color-border-ai
description: Hairline border of AI surfaces (bg-ai-subtle) and AI label chips. Decorative: never the only signal that content is AI-generated — pair with the AI label. Value shown for the Atomus brand; code follows the active brand: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-brand-300) 55%, var(--color-purple-300))

name: --color-fg-primary
description: Primary icons and non-text graphics next to text-primary.

name: --color-fg-secondary
description: Secondary icons: inputs, nav items, buttons.

name: --color-fg-tertiary
description: Muted and decorative icons. Don't use for icons that are the only label of an action.

name: --color-fg-disabled
description: Icons in disabled controls.

name: --color-fg-brand
description: Brand icons, featured-icon glyphs and active indicators. Don't use on bg-brand-solid — use fg-on-brand.

name: --color-fg-on-brand
description: Icons on bg-brand-solid fills. Only on brand-solid fills.

name: --color-fg-error
description: Error icons.

name: --color-fg-warning
description: Warning icons.

name: --color-fg-success
description: Success icons.

name: --color-fg-inverse
description: Icons on bg-inverse.

name: --color-fg-on-warning
description: Icons and dots on bg-warning-solid. Always Gray 900.

name: --color-fg-contrast
description: Maximum-contrast foreground: pure black in Light, pure white in Dark. For marks that must read on any surface (focus outlines on imagery, AI sparkle on gradients, overlays). Prefer fg-primary for ordinary icons.

name: --color-fg-contrast-inverse
description: Opposite of fg-contrast: pure white in Light, pure black in Dark. Use on fg-contrast / bg-inverse fills.
